# GoFundMe
> GoFundMe is the leading crowdfunding and fundraising platform for personal, nonprofit, emergency, and community causes.

GoFundMe helps people start fundraisers, donate to causes, support nonprofits, and access fundraising guidance, safety information, and platform policies. The site includes discovery tools, category guides, supporter resources, crisis relief hubs, and nonprofit fundraising products.

## Core Platform
- [Homepage](https://www.gofundme.com/): Main entry point for creating fundraisers, donating, and exploring platform features.
- [How GoFundMe Works](https://www.gofundme.com/c/how-it-works): Overview of starting a fundraiser, sharing it, receiving donations, and transferring funds.
- [Pricing](https://www.gofundme.com/c/pricing): Explains platform pricing, transaction fees, and cost structure for fundraisers.
- [Search](https://www.gofundme.com/s): Search fundraisers, nonprofits, and causes across the GoFundMe platform.
- [Discover](https://www.gofundme.com/discover): Browse active fundraisers by category and cause type.
- [Start a Fundraiser](https://www.gofundme.com/c/start): Entry page for creating a new personal or community fundraiser.

## Fundraiser Setup & Categories
- [Fundraising Categories](https://www.gofundme.com/c/start/fundraising-categories): Browse fundraiser types to choose the best category for a campaign.
- [Medical Fundraising](https://www.gofundme.com/c/start/medical-fundraising): Guidance for raising money for medical expenses and care needs.
- [Memorial Fundraising](https://www.gofundme.com/c/start/memorial-fundraising): Information on creating fundraisers in memory of a loved one.
- [Emergency Fundraising](https://www.gofundme.com/c/start/emergency-fundraising): Help for launching fundraisers during urgent crises and unexpected hardship.
- [Education Fundraising](https://www.gofundme.com/c/start/education-fundraising): Guidance for tuition, school, and student-related fundraising needs.
- [Animal Fundraising](https://www.gofundme.com/c/start/animal-fundraising): Support for pet care, rescue, and animal welfare fundraising.
- [Business Fundraising](https://www.gofundme.com/c/start/business-fundraising): Information for raising funds for small business and entrepreneurial needs.

## Fundraising Tips & Guides
- [Fundraising Tips](https://www.gofundme.com/c/fundraising-tips): Core guide to improving fundraiser performance and donor outreach.
- [Team Fundraising](https://www.gofundme.com/c/fundraising-tips/team): Best practices for organizing and running a fundraiser with multiple people.
- [Fundraising Ideas](https://www.gofundme.com/c/fundraising-ideas): Creative ideas and examples to inspire new fundraising campaigns.
- [Fundraising Blog](https://www.gofundme.com/c/blog): Articles covering fundraising advice, trends, and campaign success stories.
- [Successful Fundraiser Tips](https://www.gofundme.com/c/fundraising-tips): Practical advice for writing, sharing, and managing a fundraiser.
- [Share Your Fundraiser](https://www.gofundme.com/c/fundraising-tips): Tips for promotion through social sharing and supporter outreach.

## Nonprofits & Charity Fundraising
- [Charity Fundraising](https://www.gofundme.com/start/charity-fundraising): Learn how to raise money on behalf of a charity or nonprofit.
- [GoFundMe for Nonprofits](https://www.gofundme.com/c/charity-fundraising): Product and onboarding information for nonprofit organizations.
- [Sign Up as a Nonprofit](https://www.gofundme.com/c/charity-fundraising): Claim or register a nonprofit presence on GoFundMe.
- [Nonprofit Search](https://www.gofundme.com/s?nonprofits=1): Search and browse tax-deductible nonprofit organizations.
- [Social Impact Funds](https://www.gofundme.com/c/cause): Direct support for urgent needs through GoFundMe social impact initiatives.
- [Nonprofit Fundraising Resources](https://www.gofundme.com/c/charity-fundraising): Information on donor support, campaigns, and nonprofit tools.

## Crisis Relief & Giving
- [Crisis Relief](https://www.gofundme.com/c/act): Donate to verified relief efforts and urgent response campaigns.
- [Social Impact Funds](https://www.gofundme.com/c/cause): Central hub for direct support to urgent and high-impact needs.
- [Supporter Space](https://www.gofundme.com/c/supporter-space): Inspiration, giving guidance, and supporter-focused resources.
- [Discover Fundraisers](https://www.gofundme.com/discover): Explore causes across emergencies, memorials, medical needs, and more.
- [Nonprofits](https://www.gofundme.com/s?nonprofits=1): Find tax-deductible organizations available for charitable giving.

## Safety, Trust & Policies
- [GoFundMe Giving Guarantee](https://www.gofundme.com/c/safety/gofundme-guarantee): Donor protection policy covering eligible donations and fraud-related concerns.
- [Pricing](https://www.gofundme.com/c/pricing): Official explanation of fees, pricing, and payment processing costs.
- [Supported Countries](https://support.gofundme.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001972748): List of countries where GoFundMe fundraising is currently supported.
- [Safety Center](https://www.gofundme.com/c/safety): Safety and trust resources for donors and organizers.
- [Help Center](https://support.gofundme.com/hc/en-us): Support documentation for account, donations, withdrawals, and troubleshooting.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.gofundme.com/c/terms): Legal terms governing use of the GoFundMe platform.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.gofundme.com/c/privacy): Privacy information covering data collection, use, and user rights.

## Support & Help
- [Help Center](https://support.gofundme.com/hc/en-us): Official support portal for common questions and account assistance.
- [Supporter Space](https://www.gofundme.com/c/supporter-space): Donor-focused help, inspiration, and giving-related FAQs.
- [Supported Countries](https://support.gofundme.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001972748): Reference for geographic availability and country-specific fundraising support.
- [Search](https://www.gofundme.com/s): Find fundraisers, nonprofits, and causes by keyword.
- [How GoFundMe Works](https://www.gofundme.com/c/how-it-works): Introductory guide for new organizers and donors.

## Company & Platform Information
- [About GoFundMe](https://www.gofundme.com/c/about-us): Company mission, background, and overview of the fundraising platform.
- [Blog](https://www.gofundme.com/c/blog): Editorial content, fundraising stories, and platform updates.
- [Pricing](https://www.gofundme.com/c/pricing): Platform fee structure and payment processing information.
- [How It Works](https://www.gofundme.com/c/how-it-works): Product overview for fundraising and giving workflows.
- [Discover](https://www.gofundme.com/discover): Public directory of fundraisers and causes across the platform.
